name: io.github.radixguild/guild-mcp
title: Guild MCP
description: Read-only Model Context Protocol server over the Radix Guild marketplace. An agent or MCP client can browse tasks, read marketplace stats, and check its own readiness -- zero secrets on the wire, no writes, no signing. The escrow this server reads is a smart contract on Radix mainnet; the server itself is pre-audit with zero external users to date.

environmentVariables.name: GUILD_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the marketplace API base URL (default https://radixguild.com).

environmentVariables.name: GUILD_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Radix Gateway base URL (default https://mainnet.radixdlt.com).

environmentVariables.name: GUILD_ESCROW_COMPONENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the escrow component address the server reads task/claim state from.

environmentVariables.name: GUILD_AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Used only by the readiness tool to derive a public account address for on-chain checks -- never returned by any tool response (enforced by a regression test in this package).
